nodes.text: 민준 씨, 보고서는 어떻게 돼 가요?
nodes.pron: minjun ssi, bogoseoneun eotteoke dwae gayo?
nodes.trans: Minjun, how's the report coming along?

replies.text: 순조롭게 진행되고 있습니다. 거의 다 했어요.
replies.pron: sunjoropge jinhaengdoego itseumnida. geoui da haesseoyo.
replies.trans: It's going smoothly. I'm almost done.

replies.text: 사실 조금 늦어지고 있어요.
replies.pron: sasil jogeum neujeojigo isseoyo.
replies.trans: Actually, I'm a bit behind.

replies.text: 솔직히 말씀드리면, 좀 막혀 있습니다.
replies.pron: soljiki malsseumdeurimyeon, jom makyeo itseumnida.
replies.trans: To be honest, I'm a bit stuck.

nodes.text: 잘됐네요. 그럼 금요일 퇴근 전까지 괜찮죠?
nodes.pron: jaldwaenneyo. geureom geumyoil toegeun jeonkkaji gwaenchanchyo?
nodes.trans: Great. So we're still good for end of day Friday?

replies.text: 네, 문제없습니다.
replies.pron: ne, munjeeopseumnida.
replies.trans: Yes, no problem.

replies.text: 네. 내일 초안을 먼저 보여 드려도 될까요?
replies.pron: ne. naeil choaneul meonjeo boyeo deuryeodo doelkkayo?
replies.trans: Yes. Could I show you a draft tomorrow first?

replies.text: 다른 프로젝트에 급한 일이 생겨서요.
replies.pron: dareun peurojekteue geupan iri saenggyeoseoyo.
replies.trans: Something urgent came up on another project.

replies.text: 영업팀 데이터를 아직 기다리고 있어요.
replies.pron: yeongeoptim deiteoreul ajik gidarigo isseoyo.
replies.trans: I'm still waiting for data from the sales team.

nodes.text: 그래요, 말해 줘서 고마워요. 뭐가 문제예요?
nodes.pron: geuraeyo, malhae jwoseo gomawoyo. mwoga munjeyeyo?
nodes.trans: Okay, thanks for telling me. What's the problem?

replies.text: 영업팀에서 지난달 수치를 받아야 합니다.
replies.pron: yeongeoptimeseo jinandal suchireul badaya hamnida.
replies.trans: I need last month's figures from the sales team.

replies.text: 마케팅팀에서 설문 결과를 아직 안 보내 줬어요.
replies.pron: maketingtimeseo seolmun gyeolgwareul ajik an bonae jwosseoyo.
replies.trans: Marketing hasn't sent me the survey results yet.

nodes.text: 그렇군요. 그럴 수 있죠. 그럼 언제쯤 끝낼 수 있을 것 같아요?
nodes.pron: geureokunyo. geureol su itjyo. geureom eonjejjeum kkeunnael su isseul geot gatayo?
nodes.trans: I see. That happens. So when do you think you can finish?

replies.text: 이틀만 더 주실 수 있을까요?
replies.pron: iteulman deo jusil su isseulkkayo?
replies.trans: Could you give me two more days?

replies.text: 우선 내일 초안부터 보내 드릴 수 있습니다.
replies.pron: useon naeil choanbuteo bonae deuril su itseumnida.
replies.trans: I can send you a draft tomorrow first.

nodes.trans: Have you reached out to them?

replies.text: 네, 월요일에 메일을 드렸는데 아직 답이 없어요.
replies.pron: ne, woryoire meireul deuryeonneunde ajik dabi eopseoyo.
replies.trans: Yes, I emailed them on Monday, but there's no reply yet.

replies.text: 아직이요. 오늘 물어보겠습니다.
replies.pron: ajigiyo. oneul mureobogetseumnida.
replies.trans: Not yet. I'll ask them today.

nodes.text: 알겠어요. 그쪽 팀장님한테 제가 얘기해 볼게요. 내일까지는 받을 수 있을 거예요.
nodes.pron: algesseoyo. geujjok timjangnimhante jega yaegihae bolgeyo. naeilkkajineun badeul su isseul geoyeyo.
nodes.trans: Okay, I'll talk to their team lead. You should have it by tomorrow.

replies.text: 감사합니다. 그럼 마감을 다음 주 화요일로 미뤄도 될까요?
replies.pron: gamsahamnida. geureom magameul daeum ju hwayoillo mirwodo doelkkayo?
replies.trans: Thank you. Then could I push the deadline to next Tuesday?

replies.text: 감사합니다. 우선 지금 있는 자료로 초안부터 보내 드리겠습니다.
replies.pron: gamsahamnida. useon jigeum inneun jaryoro choanbuteo bonae deurigetseumnida.
replies.trans: Thank you. I'll send you a draft with what I have first.

nodes.text: 그래요. 내일까지 답이 없으면 알려 줘요.
nodes.pron: geuraeyo. naeilkkaji dabi eopseumyeon allyeo jwoyo.
nodes.trans: Okay. If you don't hear back by tomorrow, let me know.

replies.text: 알겠습니다. 그런데 시간이 조금 더 필요할 수도 있어요.
replies.pron: algetseumnida. geureonde sigani jogeum deo piryohal sudo isseoyo.
replies.trans: Understood. But I might need a little more time.

replies.text: 알겠습니다. 그래도 금요일까지 해 보겠습니다.
replies.pron: algetseumnida. geuraedo geumyoilkkaji hae bogetseumnida.
replies.trans: Understood. I'll still try to make Friday.

nodes.text: 음, 고객사 미팅이 월요일 오전이라서요. 금요일에 초안, 월요일 아침 일찍 최종본, 이렇게 어때요?
nodes.pron: eum, gogaeksa mitingi woryoil ojeoniraseoyo. geumyoire choan, woryoil achim iljjik choejongbon, ireoke eottaeyo?
nodes.trans: Hmm, the client meeting is Monday morning. How about a draft on Friday and the final version first thing Monday?

replies.text: 네, 그렇게 하겠습니다. 감사합니다.
replies.pron: ne, geureoke hagetseumnida. gamsahamnida.
replies.trans: Sure, I'll do that. Thank you.

replies.text: 조금 빠듯해서요. 차트 작업을 누가 도와주실 수 있을까요?
replies.pron: jogeum ppadeutaeseoyo. chateu jageobeul nuga dowajusil su isseulkkayo?
replies.trans: It's a bit tight. Could someone help me with the charts?

nodes.text: 그래요, 팀에서 한 명 붙여 줄게요. 그럼 금요일까지 되겠어요?
nodes.pron: geuraeyo, timeseo han myeong buchyeo julgeyo. geureom geumyoilkkaji doegesseoyo?
nodes.trans: Sure, I'll get someone on the team to help. Can you make Friday, then?

replies.text: 네, 그러면 금요일까지 끝낼 수 있습니다.
replies.pron: ne, geureomyeon geumyoilkkaji kkeunnael su itseumnida.
replies.trans: Yes, then I can finish by Friday.

replies.text: 해 보겠습니다. 혹시 모르니 내일 초안을 먼저 보내 드릴게요.
replies.pron: hae bogetseumnida. hoksi moreuni naeil choaneul meonjeo bonae deurilgeyo.
replies.trans: I'll try. Just in case, I'll send you a draft tomorrow.

nodes.text: 좋은 생각이에요. 내일 초안 보내 주면 피드백 줄게요. 최종본은 언제 줄 수 있어요?
nodes.pron: joeun saenggagieyo. naeil choan bonae jumyeon pideubaek julgeyo. choejongboneun eonje jul su isseoyo?
nodes.trans: Good idea. Send me the draft tomorrow and I'll give you feedback. When can you get me the final version?

replies.text: 월요일 오전에 드려도 될까요?
replies.pron: woryoil ojeone deuryeodo doelkkayo?
replies.trans: Could I give it to you Monday morning?

replies.text: 금요일 퇴근 전까지 드리겠습니다.
replies.pron: geumyoil toegeun jeonkkaji deurigetseumnida.
replies.trans: I'll have it to you by end of day Friday.

nodes.text: 좋아요. 그럼 일정 한번 정리해 볼까요?
nodes.pron: joayo. geureom iljeong hanbeon jeongnihae bolkkayo?
nodes.trans: Good. So shall we go over the schedule once more?

replies.text: 금요일 오후까지 초안, 월요일 오전에 최종본 드리겠습니다.
replies.pron: geumyoil ohukkaji choan, woryoil ojeone choejongbon deurigetseumnida.
replies.trans: A draft by Friday afternoon, and the final version Monday morning.

replies.text: 금요일에 초안 보내 드리고, 미팅 전에 최종본 드릴게요.
replies.pron: geumyoire choan bonae deurigo, miting jeone choejongbon deurilgeyo.
replies.trans: I'll send the draft on Friday and the final version before the meeting.

nodes.text: 좋아요. 그럼 금요일 퇴근 전까지예요. 무슨 일 생기면 바로 말해 줘요.
nodes.pron: joayo. geureom geumyoil toegeun jeonkkajiyeyo. museun il saenggimyeon baro malhae jwoyo.
nodes.trans: Great. End of day Friday, then. If anything comes up, tell me right away.

nodes.text: 좋아요. 미리 말해 줘서 고마워요, 민준 씨. 도움이 필요하면 언제든 말해요.
nodes.pron: joayo. miri malhae jwoseo gomawoyo, minjun ssi. doumi piryohamyeon eonjedeun malhaeyo.
nodes.trans: Good. Thanks for telling me early, Minjun. If you need help, just say so.

nodes.text: 월요일 오전도 괜찮아요. 대신 열 시 전까지 부탁해요. 초안 보고 연락할게요.
nodes.pron: woryoil ojeondo gwaenchanayo. daesin yeol si jeonkkaji butakaeyo. choan bogo yeollakalgeyo.
nodes.trans: Monday morning is fine. But before ten, please. I'll look at the draft and get back to you.
